description: This is a main module for search functionality within the LiteLLM project. It defines both synchronous and asynchronous search functions, handling parameter construction, environment setup, and external HTTP requests for search operations. The file integrates with provider configurations, logging, and HTTP handling classes, and references various internal modules and types related to search providers and responses.
